evidence.observation: Exhaust O2 was 5.2 ppm near the end of the ramp, following a stable low-oxygen baseline.
O2 has increased monotonically during growth from 13.5 ppm at 2520 s to 54.5 ppm, indicating an unexplained atmosphere change.
Temperature is 749.4 °C against 750 °C setpoint and Ar is 100.6 sccm against 100 sccm; controller reports running, which does not resolve the atmosphere concern.
Tube pressure gauge is not installed; pressure remains unavailable, preventing verification of the required growth-stage pressure.

args.missing_evidence: Verified tube pressure and acceptable growth-stage atmosphere limits are needed; independent oxygen verification and leak/exhaust-path checks would discriminate possible causes of the O2 rise. No sample characterization is available.
